gen-gf-aboreto-satoshi: Wide-spaced, ladle-bowled capitals up top. Satoshi follows in a sans with a soaring x-height and single-width strokes, so paragraphs would read smoothly and without fuss.
gen-gf-aboreto-switzer: Switzer reads as wiry and upright, its constant-width strokes standing tall. Under Aboreto, whose heavy stems meet razor-fine cross strokes, a long page of it would move along easily, like clean signage.
gen-gf-aboreto-work-sans: Work Sans draws its letters with the fine, even line of a technical pen, high mean line and all. Aboreto handles the drama with its heavy-light split, and the body font handles the steady, everyday reading.
gen-gf-agu-display-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans keeps generous gaps where its curves meet the stem, sharp and refined in a plain sans way. Agu Display, with its looped tubing strokes, is the showpiece; the body font is the one that does the quiet work.
gen-gf-anybody-archivo: Loud heading, sturdy text. Anybody packs its lowercase up toward the caps, while Archivo opens its curves outward; a slightly smaller size for the body would let that commanding x-height breathe.
gen-gf-anybody-fs-asap: Anybody's lowercase crowds right up against its capitals, with flared curve ends that stay apart. And Asap, a plain sans with open arcs and a body height nearly matching its capitals, keeps everything readable below it.
gen-gf-anybody-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro reads like bent steel rod, its curve endings keeping well apart. Anybody's heading has a low, marker-like stroke by comparison, so a long run of the sans body feels crisp and unhurried.
gen-gf-anybody-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads loose and curvy, a wire-like sans-serif with tall bodies and stubby ascender tips. And beneath Anybody's low, bold heading, its signage-like plainness would carry a long page without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-anybody-fs-merriweather-sans: Big, sturdy, unmistakable. Anybody flares its curve ends and packs its lowercase up high; Merriweather Sans does the steadier job, its tall sans lowercase and openly facing e keeping words large and legible.
gen-gf-anybody-fs-public-sans: Tight-packed and punchy up top. Anybody's flared curves lead, while Public Sans offers a hefty, broad-countered sans below; letting the body run a touch smaller than the heading would suit it.
